## What changed

Describe the smallest useful behavior change and why it belongs in WireAtlas.

## Validation

- [ ] Strict-warning build succeeds
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] New parser branches include malformed-input coverage
- [ ] Examples use only synthetic documentation values
- [ ] No capture, credential, internal name, or identifying data is included
- [ ] I have read and agree to the contribution terms in `LICENSE`
